title: A gun, a crew, a working yard

steps.purpose: Iona Venn is holding Marker Eleven’s registry against the cordon. Secure the rolls and Halloran releases her crated Focused Medium Laser after victory. The cabinet reward is separate from uncertain enemy salvage.
steps.practice: Pause, choose an approach and clear the cordon together. On return, find Venn’s cabinet receipt in the company report and its emitter in stores.

steps.purpose: The next main job rescues Nera Pell’s crew from Cut Nine. Protect the cradle and hold its winch. Venn’s optic gives a refitted scout a longer firing lane. The optional reader survey remains available.
steps.practice: Try the optic in a Gadfly’s left arm in place of its Flamer: one tonne, one box. Name and save Lamplighter, then deploy it in a detail up to 140 tonnes. Cover the winch; do not chase the west guard.

steps.purpose: Pell’s crew returns to Sarn Gantry Three, and Kestrel follows. Your original four total the 205-tonne lift allowance. The released Prybar hulk offers another company choice once rebuilt, armed and crewed.
steps.practice: Choose who guards the gantry and who runs for west stores. Rebuilding a hulk does not arm it. Keep a defender on the work while a faster machine collects the optional cabinet.

steps.purpose: Ada Rusk and her service cart are trapped beyond Apron Seven’s cordon. Clear the Tender approach to recover its Focused Large Laser under signed custody. The delivery is separate from enemy salvage.
steps.practice: Use your reach and cover your sides. After victory, inspect Rusk’s delivery in stores. The recovered optic is useful equipment, not a free repair.

steps.purpose: At Cutbank, Len Saye stays with the original repair rolls. Secure both posts without destroying them. Rusk’s long optic can support a garden approach around the fixed gun; it cannot shoot through the buildings.
steps.practice: Swap one Halberd Large Laser for Rusk’s Focused Large Laser: same five tonnes and two boxes. Name and save Long Watch. Use the extra reach, allow for its slower cycle and keep heat safety on.

steps.purpose: Saye brings the two originals into Sarn Registry Court. Hold the record through its copy while local crews attack both streets. The temporary loadway’s 175-tonne limit leaves one of your opening four at the Tender.
steps.practice: Choose a heavy firing line or keep the Votive’s fast eyes. Three heavy choices total 170 tonnes; including the Votive changes your weapons and mobility. Guard the court rather than pursue every contact.
